content.content:
User wants a 7-day travel plan, 5 people, departing from La Crosse (presumably La Crosse, WI). Visiting 3 cities in Illinois. Dates March 18-24 2022 (7 days). Budget $4800. Need accommodations suitable for children under 10, entire rooms. Prefer no flights. So likely drive (car) or bus/train. Need to create plan with daily entries: day 1 to day 7. For each day, need city, transportation (e.g., "Drive: La Crosse to Springfield, 4h"), breakfast, attractions (multiple), lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We must call submit_day_plan for each day. Must fill fields; if not applicable use "-". Need to include transportation each day (maybe include travel details on days when moving). Provide restaurant names etc. Should be plausible.

We need to ensure budget: $4800 for 5 people for 7 days includes accommodation and meals maybe. We can note approximate costs but not required. Provide child-friendly hotels.

Cities in Illinois: maybe Chicago, Springfield, Peoria (or Rockford). Starting from La Crosse, WI to Chicago is about 3h. Then maybe to Springfield (2h) then to Peoria (1h). Or order: Day 1 drive to Chicago, spend 2 days, then Springfield, then Peoria, then return.

We need 7 days: March 18 (Day1) start La Crosse drive to Chicago. Day2 explore Chicago. Day3 travel to Springfield. Day4 explore Springfield. Day5 travel to Peoria. Day6 explore Peoria. Day7 return to La Crosse.

Provide attractions like Shedd Aquarium, Navy Pier, etc. Provide child-friendly meals.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
